predictions.articleTitle: Busan I Park vs Cheongju Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Playoff-Chasing Hosts Break Away Draw Hoodoo?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Home Win / Draw captures Busan I Park's strong home set-piece and table edge alongside Cheongju's persistent away draw threat in a projected 2:1 or 1:1 contest.
possibilityAssessment: Busan I Park hold a 60.0% home win rate and league-high 16 set-piece goals against a Cheongju defense on a three-match losing skid (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 goals and 3 total goals align with a 2.83 combined lambda and Cheongju's 61.5% away Over 2.5 frequency, with 2 goals as the secondary 1:1 branch (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
A 1:1 stalemate hedge protects against Busan's 30.8% big-chance waste rate without suspended striker Cristian if Kim Chan is limited (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Busan's 16 set-piece goals test Cheongju's six-game unbeaten away run.

spf.comment: Busan's 60.0% home win rate and playoff urgency lead a 2:1 projection, while Cheongju's 7 away draws and Busan's forward absences make a 1:1 draw risk too substantial for a single call.

over_under.comment: Combined goal lambda of 2.83, Busan's recent 3:1 and 2:1 home wins, and Cheongju's 61.5% away Over 2.5 rate support 3+ total goals.

btts.comment: Both sides concede frequently (Busan 33.3% home clean sheets; Cheongju 17.2% overall) while Cheongju's 69.2% away BTTS rate supports both attacks scoring.

score.comment: 2:1 reflects Busan's 1.60 home lambda over Cheongju's 1.63 conceded average, while 1:1 matches the 11.6% modal Poisson draw scenario.

goals.comment: 3 goals align with the primary 2:1 Over 2.5 projection, whereas 2 goals capture the modal 1:1 stalemate branch.

bqc.comment: Busan have won all 11 matches when leading at half-time (Win-Win), whereas Cheongju's 53.8% away half-time draw rate supports Draw-Draw in a cagey first half.
